COMMAND.name: show status
COMMAND.help: Status BIRD: versi, uptime, waktu rekonfigurasi terakhir (birdc show status)

COMMAND.name: show protocols
COMMAND.help: Daftar instance protokol BIRD + status (birdc show protocols [nama])

COMMAND.name: show protocols all
COMMAND.help: Daftar instance protokol BIRD, verbose (birdc show protocols all [nama])

COMMAND.name: show bgp summary
COMMAND.help: Ringkasan BGP ala vendor (KOMPOSISI klish: show protocols all + show route count per neighbor; BIRD tidak punya perintah ini)

COMMAND.name: show symbols
COMMAND.help: Simbol yang didefinisikan di konfigurasi BIRD (birdc show symbols [kind])

COMMAND.name: show symbols table
COMMAND.help: Simbol tabel routing (birdc show symbols table)

COMMAND.name: show symbols filter
COMMAND.help: Simbol filter (birdc show symbols filter)

COMMAND.name: show symbols function
COMMAND.help: Simbol fungsi (birdc show symbols function)

COMMAND.name: show symbols protocol
COMMAND.help: Simbol protokol (birdc show symbols protocol)

COMMAND.name: show symbols template
COMMAND.help: Simbol template (birdc show symbols template)

COMMAND.name: show symbols roa
COMMAND.help: Simbol ROA (birdc show symbols roa)

COMMAND.name: show symbols symbol
COMMAND.help: Satu simbol (birdc show symbols symbol)

COMMAND.name: show interfaces bird
COMMAND.help: Interface yang dilihat BIRD (birdc show interfaces) — bedakan dari `show interfaces` OS

COMMAND.name: show interfaces bird summary
COMMAND.help: Interface yang dilihat BIRD, ringkas (birdc show interfaces summary)

COMMAND.name: show route
COMMAND.help: Isi tabel routing BIRD (birdc show route)

COMMAND.name: show route all
COMMAND.help: Route + semua atribut (birdc show route all)

COMMAND.name: show route count
COMMAND.help: Hanya statistik route (birdc show route count)

COMMAND.name: show route stats
COMMAND.help: Statistik route (birdc show route stats)

COMMAND.name: show route for
COMMAND.help: Route yang dipakai forwarding ke destinasi ini (birdc show route for <prefix>)

COMMAND.name: show route in
COMMAND.help: Semua prefix yang tercakup prefix ini (birdc show route in <prefix>)

COMMAND.name: show route table
COMMAND.help: Route dari satu tabel (birdc show route table <nama|all>)

COMMAND.name: show route table all
COMMAND.help: Route dari semua tabel (birdc show route table all)

COMMAND.name: show route protocol
COMMAND.help: Hanya route dari satu protokol (birdc show route protocol <nama>)

COMMAND.name: show route export
COMMAND.help: Route yang di-export ke protokol ini (birdc show route export <nama>)

COMMAND.name: show route preexport
COMMAND.help: Route export tanpa export filter (birdc show route preexport <nama>)

COMMAND.name: show route noexport
COMMAND.help: Route yang ditolak export filter (birdc show route noexport <nama>)

COMMAND.name: show route where
COMMAND.help: Route cocok kondisi filter, pakai kutip: show route where "net ~ [ 10.0.0.0/8+ ]" (birdc show route where <kondisi>)

COMMAND.name: show route filter
COMMAND.help: Uji filter inline terhadap tabel route (birdc show route filter { if ... then accept; }); bentuk bernama TIDAK didukung BIRD 2.20 — hanya inline

PARAM.name: cond
PARAM.help: Kondisi COND satu token (mis. net~10.0.0.0/8 atau roa:R4,net,bgp_path.last=ROA_VALID)

COMMAND.name: show route import
COMMAND.help: Import table channel (birdc show route import table <protokol.channel>)

COMMAND.name: show route primary
COMMAND.help: Hanya route primary (aktif) di tabel (birdc show route primary)

COMMAND.name: show route primary count
COMMAND.help: Statistik route primary (birdc show route primary count)

COMMAND.name: show route filtered
COMMAND.help: Route yang tertahan filter (tidak primary) di tabel (birdc show route filtered)

COMMAND.name: show route filtered count
COMMAND.help: Statistik route tertahan filter (birdc show route filtered count)

COMMAND.name: show route import table
COMMAND.help: Isi import table satu channel (birdc show route import table <protokol.channel>); channel tanpa import table menjawab kosong

COMMAND.name: show route export table
COMMAND.help: Isi export table satu channel (birdc show route export table <protokol.channel>); channel tanpa export table menjawab kosong

COMMAND.name: show ospf interface
COMMAND.help: Info detail interface OSPF (birdc show ospf interface [nama] [interface])

COMMAND.name: show ospf neighbors
COMMAND.help: Tetangga OSPF + state adjacency (birdc show ospf neighbors [nama] [interface])

COMMAND.help: Info area OSPF dari LSDB (birdc show ospf state [all|nama])

PARAM.name: name
PARAM.help: all atau nama instance; kosong = ringkas semua

COMMAND.name: show ospf state all
COMMAND.help: Info semua node di LSDB OSPF (birdc show ospf state all)

COMMAND.name: show ospf topology
COMMAND.help: Topologi area OSPF dari LSDB, ringkas (birdc show ospf topology [all|nama])

PARAM.name: name
PARAM.help: all atau nama instance; kosong = ringkas semua

COMMAND.name: show ospf topology all
COMMAND.help: Topologi semua node di LSDB OSPF (birdc show ospf topology all)

COMMAND.name: show ospf lsadb
COMMAND.help: Isi OSPF LSA database (birdc show ospf lsadb; filter area/type/lsid belum diekspos)

COMMAND.name: show rip interfaces
COMMAND.help: Info detail interface RIP (birdc show rip interfaces [nama] [interface])

COMMAND.name: show rip neighbors
COMMAND.help: Tetangga RIP + state (birdc show rip neighbors [nama] [interface])

COMMAND.name: configure reload
COMMAND.help: Muat ulang bird.conf ke daemon yang sedang jalan (birdc configure; setara SIGHUP)

COMMAND.name: configure check
COMMAND.help: Cek validitas bird.conf tanpa apply (birdc configure check)

COMMAND.name: configure confirm
COMMAND.help: Konfirmasi konfigurasi berjalan, matikan timer undo (birdc configure confirm)

COMMAND.name: configure undo
COMMAND.help: Kembali ke konfigurasi sebelumnya, satu level (birdc configure undo)

COMMAND.name: configure soft
COMMAND.help: Muat ulang konfigurasi tanpa restart protokol (birdc configure soft)

COMMAND.name: configure timeout
COMMAND.help: Muat ulang konfigurasi dengan timer undo (birdc configure timeout [detik]; tanpa angka = 300 dtk; konfirmasi: configure confirm)

COMMAND.name: configure file
COMMAND.help: Muat konfigurasi dari file lain (birdc configure "<file>"; file harus ada + bisa dibaca)

COMMAND.name: configure soft timeout
COMMAND.help: Muat ulang tanpa restart protokol + timer undo (birdc configure soft timeout [detik])

COMMAND.name: configure soft file
COMMAND.help: Muat konfigurasi dari file lain tanpa restart protokol (birdc configure soft "<file>")

COMMAND.name: configure file timeout
COMMAND.help: Muat konfigurasi dari file lain + timer undo (birdc configure "<file>" timeout [detik])

COMMAND.name: configure soft file timeout
COMMAND.help: Muat konfigurasi dari file lain tanpa restart protokol + timer undo (birdc configure soft "<file>" timeout [detik])

COMMAND.name: debug
COMMAND.help: Kontrol debugging protokol: debug <protokol|pola|all> all|off|states,routes,filters,interfaces,events,packets

PARAM.name: proto
PARAM.help: Nama protokol, pola (* diizinkan), atau all

COMMAND.name: debug all
COMMAND.help: Nyalakan semua debugging semua protokol (birdc debug all all)

COMMAND.name: debug off
COMMAND.help: Matikan semua debugging semua protokol (birdc debug all off)

COMMAND.name: down
COMMAND.help: Matikan daemon BIRD — perintah ini HANYA menampilkan konfirmasi; eksekusi: down confirm

COMMAND.name: down confirm
COMMAND.help: EKSEKUSI: matikan daemon BIRD (birdc down)

COMMAND.name: graceful-restart
COMMAND.help: Matikan daemon BIRD untuk graceful restart — perintah ini HANYA menampilkan konfirmasi; eksekusi: graceful-restart confirm

COMMAND.name: graceful-restart confirm
COMMAND.help: EKSEKUSI: matikan daemon BIRD untuk graceful restart (birdc graceful restart)

COMMAND.name: eval
COMMAND.help: Evaluasi ekspresi filter BIRD, pakai kutip: eval "1+2" (birdc eval <expr>)

COMMAND.name: echo
COMMAND.help: Kontrol echo log ke output CLI: echo all|off|info,warning,error,fatal,debug,trace,remote,auth,bug

PARAM.name: spec
PARAM.help: all | off | daftar kelas log koma

COMMAND.name: dump
COMMAND.help: Dump struktur data internal BIRD ke file (file belum boleh ada; hanya readable user daemon)

COMMAND.name: mrt
COMMAND.help: Perintah MRT on-demand (birdc mrt dump table)

COMMAND.name: mrt dump
COMMAND.help: Dump MRT on-demand

COMMAND.name: mrt dump table
COMMAND.help: Dump isi tabel routing ke file MRT (birdc mrt dump table <tabel> to <file>; filter/where belum diekspos)

COMMAND.name: timeformat
COMMAND.help: Override format tanggal/waktu sesi birdc ini saja (birdc timeformat <format> [limit <format2>]); format konfigurasi ada di bird global

PARAM.name: fmt
PARAM.help: Format: iso long|iso long ms|iso long us|iso short|iso short ms|iso short us, atau strftime mengandung % (kutip bila mengandung spasi)

COMMAND.name: birdc
COMMAND.help: Perintah birdc mentah (kutip seluruhnya, mis. birdc "show status"); down/graceful restart diblok — pakai gerbang konfirmasi

COMMAND.name: birdc socket
COMMAND.help: Tampilkan/set socket kontrol birdc yang dipakai klish (default: bird.ctl); set wajib socket sudah ada + menjawab birdc

PARAM.name: path
PARAM.help: Path socket UNIX absolut; kosong = tampilkan saja

COMMAND.name: birdc socket-del
COMMAND.help: Kembalikan socket kontrol birdc ke default (bird.ctl)
